messages:
Maya: Heads up — spotted a bunch of minor but annoying mismatches between the in-product docs panel and the console UI.
Maya: Examples: the console shows \"Model Profile\" but docs call it \"Model Variant\"; the docs links open a new tab instead of the sidecar; help copy for the routing dropdown is missing the phrase \"fallback model\".
Zane: Oh good catch. Which flows did you see this in? Deploy / model config / serving routes?
Maya: Mostly in: Model config modal, Route create flow, and the per-model detail pane. Also the quick help tooltip on the dashboard chart says "See docs" but links to docs.redwood.com which loses context.
Jules: screenshots? can you drop one inline or paste a quick diff of the labels? :eyes:
Maya: pasted a tiny snippet —
```
Console:   Label: Model Profile
Docs:      Label: Model Variant
```
Maya: And this is the anchor behavior — clicking help opens a new tab instead of the docs sidecar. Keyboard users lose focus.
Elaine: accessibility snag — opening in a new tab without an announcement is aa11y issue. We should either open sidecar or add aria-label that includes "opens new tab". Also need to ensure focus is trapped to the sidecar if we use it.
Zane: I think the sidecar is preferred. Keeps users in context and we already have the sidecar pattern for alerts. Are there any polyfills that block deep linking to a specific doc anchor?
Jules: We can update the link behavior from `<a href=... target=_blank rel=noopener>` to a sidecar route: `/console/docs?anchor=...&sidecar=true` and have the console router open the docs panel. That retains scroll position and focus.
Maya: That works. UX copy decision: which term do we standardize on — "Model Variant" or "Model Profile"? My vote: Model Variant (matches OSS docs and infra).
Zane: Agreed. Product prefers "Model Variant" because it maps to model family + weights. Make a single source-of-truth in docs and console strings.
Jules: I'll update the UI copy and export a localization key `model.variant.label` so intl keys are consistent. Also will add a tiny support copy under the dropdown: "Select a model variant (weights + config)".
Elaine: I'll add an automated E2E that asserts focus order when the sidecar opens and that link has `aria-describedby` pointing to the sidecar header. Also add a test to ensure links include an accessible name when they still open a new tab.
Maya: One more nit: the docs panel's breadcrumb says "Docs › Serving" but console breadcrumbs use "Docs / Inference". Can we align taxonomy?
Zane: Product taxonomy should be: Docs › Inference › Serving. Template all docs breadcrumbs to use the product nav keys.
Jules: Action items:
 - Jules: update copy keys + sidecar link behavior PR (will include a screenshot of the new help link state).
 - Elaine: add a11y e2e + test for focus and aria attributes.
 - Maya: sweep docs anchors, add alias redirects from old anchors (docs router).
 - Zane: confirm taxonomy changes and update docs nav JSON.
Maya: rough timeline?
Zane: aim for a tiny PR this week for copy & link behavior; Elaine's tests next sprint.
Jules: I'll stub the UI changes and leave comments for localization.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled at 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC — please don't merge conflicting routing changes after 01:30 UTC.
Maya: noted — will avoid touching deploy-critical files. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Zane: thanks — once PRs are up, tag `#product` and `#eng-runtime` so infra can review routing impact.
Elaine: also cc `security` if we change `rel` attributes or link handling.
Maya: will do. Closing for now, will post the PR link when ready.
